key_insight: AdamW’s fixed points match stationary points of an implicit constrained, regularized objective, but some are unstable and need not attract its trajectories.
engineering_relevance: Reliable use of AdamW requires attention to curvature, weight decay, and momentum, which can affect stability even near stationary points.
method: Characterize AdamW’s fixed points through an implicit optimization objective.
Analyze one-dimensional instability and derive sufficient local stability conditions for higher-dimensional continuous-time dynamics.
Propose a convergent modification that preserves AdamW’s fixed points.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical stability results and persistent oscillations even in one dimension, but provides no dataset benchmarks or quantitative evaluations.
watch_item: Higher-dimensional continuous-time local stability conditions do not by themselves guarantee convergence of practical discrete-time AdamW.
paper_title: A Stability Analysis of AdamW: Unstable Equilibria and Non-Convergence
